_comment: Storage proxy mount table. Copy to config.mounts.json (gitignored) and set ENABLE_STORAGE_PROXY=1. Each mount serves an S3 bucket as read-only byte passthrough from a backend, ALONGSIDE the relational->Iceberg path. Backends: 'local' (a filesystem path, incl. an OS-mounted NFS/SMB share), 's3' (native S3/MinIO), 'azure' (Azure Blob/ADLS), and 'gcs' (Google Cloud Storage). 'root' is the filesystem path / upstream bucket / container respectively. Secrets live in the encrypted credential store keyed by 'credential' where supported; GCS uses ADC/workload identity and must set 'auth' ('adc'/'anonymous'). The bucket must differ from the DB warehouse bucket (S3_BUCKET).
